tool.name: company_job_postings
tool.title: Company Job Postings (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby)
tool.description:
Collect live job postings straight from company career boards in one call: one row per open job with company, ATS, job id, title, location, department, employment type, workplace type, posting date, apply URL, salary text when the board publishes it, and the description as plain text (optional). Give it board tokens or career-page URLs for Greenhouse ('stripe'), Lever ('leverdemo') or Ashby ('ramp'). A call must name at least one board.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/job-postings-scraper'.
- Side Effects: Reads each platform's public job-board JSON endpoint (the same data the company's own careers page loads) and creates a billed Actor run and dataset on your Apify account. No login, no API key, no cookies, no browser.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typically 2-20 seconds. $0.003 per job row plus $0.005 per run. Up to 100 boards per platform and 20,000 rows per run; max_jobs_per_company defaults to 100.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use for hiring-signal lead lists (which accounts are opening which roles), job-market research across many companies, recruiting and competitor intel, or filling a job board or newsletter with fresh roles from companies you choose.
- When NOT to use: Do not use for closed or archived postings (boards expose currently open jobs only), for LinkedIn, Indeed or ZipRecruiter aggregator data, or for Workable boards (its public endpoint rate-limits datacenter IPs and is deliberately not supported).
- Named alternatives: the other tools in this package cover Shopify catalogs, app stores, podcasts and newsletters, not job boards.

Honest limits: only Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby are supported; a private or removed board returns nothing for that company and the run continues with the rest; boards that publish no posting date or salary leave those fields null rather than inventing them; descriptions are trimmed to 4,000 characters. Board lists are sent explicitly on every call, so an omitted platform is skipped, never replaced by a hidden default search.

greenhouse.description: Greenhouse board tokens or URLs, e.g. 'stripe' or 'https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe'. Leave out to skip Greenhouse.

lever.description: Lever board tokens or URLs, e.g. 'leverdemo' or 'https://jobs.lever.co/leverdemo'. Leave out to skip Lever.

ashby.description: Ashby organisation names or URLs, e.g. 'ramp' or 'https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp'. Leave out to skip Ashby.

max_jobs_per_company.description: Upper limit of postings returned per company (hard maximum 100). Each row is a billed result.

include_description.description: When true, each row carries the posting description as plain text trimmed to 4,000 characters. Set false for a smaller, faster dataset.

query.description: Optional keyword filter applied to job title and description, e.g. 'engineer'. Leave empty for all jobs.

posted_within_days.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 means no date filter; boards that expose no date are kept.

ats.title: ATS
ats.description: Source platform: greenhouse, lever or ashby.

jobId.title: Job ID
jobId.description: Posting id on the source platform.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location text as the board states it.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department or team, when the board publishes one.

employmentType.title: Employment type
employmentType.description: Full-time, contract, etc. when stated; otherwise null.

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: Remote, hybrid or on-site when stated; otherwise null.

postedAt.title: Posted at
postedAt.description: Posting date, ISO 8601, when the board exposes it.

salaryText.title: Salary text
salaryText.description: Salary range as published by the board, otherwise null.

description.title: Description
description.description: Plain-text posting description, max 4,000 characters; null when include_description is false.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: When the row was collected, ISO 8601.
